title: Health Overflow Fix
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp)](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

This is a simple mod that prevents the Player's health from going past it's max.

When playing with a ton of mods that change attributes it is easy to be in a situation where the health is past its max. So this mod fixes that in a simple way.

This mod only can be noticed while using mods that influence the health bar.

If you want to get updates on the mod development, report bugs or suggest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server: [https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG](https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG)
